title: Private Deployments - Weekly Standup & Engineering Notes (2026-03-02)
content:
Weekly Private Deployments Standup - 2026-03-02

Attendees: Aisha, Jon, Lena, Marcus, Priya, Devon

Purpose: consolidate status across VPC/on-prem installer workstreams, review customer blockers, and surface action items before Friday sync with Solutions Engineering. This doc is a working log (notes + standup updates) — not yet finalized.

Highlights / Executive summary:
- Installer v1.4 RC1 is performing well in lab; main regressions are around upgrade path for operator and preflight false-positives in heterogeneous customer networks.
- Two customer-facing blockers open: PD-4521 (air-gapped install failing on cert provisioning) and PD-4589 (network MTU + SNAT causing service routing failures). Both are high priority; SE is engaged.
- KMS/HSM work: initial HSM integration PR merged to staging, but customer key policies require additional audit logging (security request).

Standup-style updates (by person):
- Aisha (owner, release coordinator):
  - Cut RC1 for private-installer v1.4 on 2026-03-01. Smoke tests pass on standard VPC template.
  - Coordinating with Solutions Eng for PD-4521 customer; preparing manual cert bundle workaround and a comms brief.
  - Blocker: need a short-term doc for customers on manual CA upload for air-gapped installs.

- Jon (installer / preflight lead):
  - Fixed two preflight checks that were too strict (docker daemon cgroup path and systemd-resolved edge case). Patches in PR #78.
  - Observed recurring false-positive for network service reachability when MTU < 1500 (common on some bare-metal setups). Investigating fallback behavior.
  - Blocker: need a test cluster with MTU=9000 to reproduce customer issue; reaching out to infra for a lab node.

- Lena (operator / helm charts):
  - Addressed operator crash during upgrade (null pointer on annotation) — root cause: older CRDs in customer clusters. Implemented forward-compatible CRD check + migration plan.
  - Preparing a small hotfix to be backported to 1.3.x for customers on the upgrade path.
  - Blocker: confirm with QA on upgrade test matrix for edge Kubernetes versions (1.24 and 1.25).

- Marcus (networking, VPC templates):
  - Added explicit SNAT rules and clearer doc for customer-provided NAT gateways; this mitigates service egress issues observed in PD-4589.
  - Noted that some customers have restrictive firewall policies blocking inter-node VXLAN traffic; added optional instructions for configuring nodeport exceptions.
  - Blocker: need Solutions Eng to get firewall rule lists from the impacted customer to craft a bespoke proposal.

- Priya (security / KMS):
  - Merged HSM adapter into staging; ran basic key wrap/unwrap tests with SoftHSM.
  - Customer audit requirement: some enterprise customers require HSM audit logs forwarded to their SIEM — need to surface expected log formats and retention.
  - Blocker: KMS team waiting on security/legal guidance re: PII in logs before enabling full-audit pipeline.

- Devon (storage and perf):
  - Investigated slow model-load times reported in on-prem customer cluster — confirmed I/O stall on PVC backed by NFS with sync=true. Recommending PVC policy changes and a temporary pre-warm step.
  - Implemented a quick config toggle to disable pre-warm in the operator for affected workloads.
  - Blocker: need to coordinate with customer SRE to test performance patch in their staging.

Customer Blockers (priority):
- PD-4521 (air-gapped installs failing on cert provisioning) — status: engaged; workaround: manual CA upload + temporary bootstrap script. Action: Aisha to send comms and step-by-step by EOD 2026-03-03.
- PD-4589 (MTU/SNAT causing inter-service routing failures) — status: reproducing in lab pending MTU=9000 node. Action: Jon + Marcus to validate lab repro; SE to collect customer network config.
- PD-4602 (HSM audit logs format) — status: security review requested. Action: Priya to coordinate with Security & Legal by 2026-03-05.

Decisions made:
- Backport hotfix to 1.3.x for operator upgrade crash (Lena owns). Target release: 2026-03-05.
- For air-gapped cert provisioning, we will ship a documented manual CA import workflow in RC1, but keep automations disabled until PD customer confirms staging success.
- Temporarily relax preflight strictness for network checks where MRU/MTU mismatch is likely; add prominent warning to operator output rather than hard fail. (Jon to implement conditional check toggle).

Action items & owners (concise):
- Aisha: Draft and send PD-4521 comms (manual CA upload steps + temporary script) — due 2026-03-03.
- Jon: Provision MTU=9000 lab node and validate PD-4589 repro; add conditional preflight toggle — due 2026-03-04.
- Lena: Prepare operator 1.3.x hotfix PR and coordinate QA — due 2026-03-05.
- Marcus: Work with SE to get customer firewall rule dump for PD-4589; update VPC doc with NAT/SNAT examples — due 2026-03-04.
- Priya: Get security/legal sign-off on HSM/audit-log approach and document expected formats — due 2026-03-05.
- Devon: Coordinate storage perf test with customer SRE for the NFS PVC patch — due 2026-03-06.

Notes / troubleshooting tips & known workarounds (for SEs):
- Air-gapped installs: manual CA upload works reliably; provide both PEM bundle and passphrase option. Keep an offline USB-friendly tarball with certs and installers.
- MTU-related failures: recommend customers to test a simple iperf between nodes; if MTU < 1500, temporarily set operator flag --network-preflight=warn and enable explicit MTU config in the node config.
- Slow model load on NFS: suggest switching to block storage for model PVCs or set async write options; pre-warm model files with dd if=/dev/zero to allocate blocks before runtime.

Meeting notes (2026-03-02 sync):
- Discussed trade-offs for preflight strictness: team agreed that blocking installs for ambiguous network issues is a poor customer experience; will convert some failures to warnings and surface clear remediation steps in UI/CLI.
- Confirmed backport necessity for operator crash fix; backlog reprioritized to meet 1.3.x customers.
- Raised potential process improvement: capture customer preflight config at onboarding (template + sample outputs) so we can replicate network/fstab/cgroup variants in lab.

Risks & follow-ups:
- If we relax preflight checks too much, we may ship installs that fail later in production; mitigation: make warnings prominent and require acceptance flag for installs with warnings.
- KMS audit logging delay may block some enterprise customers from completing compliance review; escalate with Sales/AE if legal guidance not available by 2026-03-05.

Next steps / next meeting:
- Daily async updates in thread #private-deployments; weekly sync Friday 2026-03-06 10:00 PT. Bring SE updates for PD-4521 and PD-4589.

Appendix (quick links & snippets):
- Manual CA upload skeleton (to be expanded in the comms brief):
  1) scp ca-bundle.pem root@bootstrap-node:/etc/ssl/local-ca.pem
  2) run ./installer --install-mode=airgap --ca=/etc/ssl/local-ca.pem --config=config.yaml
  3) follow logs (kubectl -n redwood logs -f redwood-installer)

- Quick preflight toggle example: --network-preflight=warn (operator will emit warning code PF_NET_MTU_01)

This doc will be updated after the 2026-03-03 SE call and again before the Friday release decision.

-- Aisha (on behalf of eng-private-deployments)
